svg.text: THE SALT-ARCH VILLA — ADRIATA WESTERN CLIFFSIDE
Summer Court Guest Wing (Autumn Delegation Quarters) & Prince's Vaulted Sea-Cavern • Dragonbound Architectural Plate
I. MAIN VILLA DECK — CANTILEVERED OVER ADRIATA BAY (ELEV. +38 m)
(38 m sheer drop to surf below)
II. LOWER LEVEL — PRINCE'S VAULTED SEA-CAVERN (DIRECTLY BELOW VILLA, ELEV. +6 m)
36 m Deep × 24 m Wide × 16 m Vaulted
Dry Sea-Sand Bed • Cool Limestone Recess
• Single Palace Bottleneck: Only one guarded cliff-bridge links the villa to Tarquin's
palace. Caelum holds the gate; unannounced visitors cannot slip in unseen.
• Private Inner Corridor: Connects Eris's and Aurelie's wings behind the salon —
no crossing the glass deck after dark, and lockable from inside.
• Prince's Sightline Cover: 32 m of solid cliff rock plus crashing surf below the
villa floor mask Prince's movements from Summer Court balconies.
